description: Lobulated isointense T1/T2 signal enhancing pineal region mass with perilesional thalamic and midbrain edema. Small non-enhancing cystic focus on the right. Dorsal midbrain mass effect with effacement of the cerebral aqueduct results in mild hydrocephalus with periventricular high FLAIR signal representing transependymal edema.
